A [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] named '''Hego Damask''' was [[Caar Damask]]'s clan father, who named [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|his own son]]&mdash;and Hego Damask I's grandson&mdash;after him.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hego Damask I was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] written by author [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
